name: apply_effect
description: Apply a named effect (spell, condition, curse, etc.) to one or more targets. Effects support three independent removal mechanisms that can be combined freely: (1) duration — auto-expires via advance_turn after a fixed number of rounds; (2) concentration — cleared automatically when the caster drops concentration via clear_concentration; (3) save to end — at the end of each of the target's turns, advance_turn rolls the specified saving throw and removes the effect on a success (models Hold Person, Paralyzed, Stunned, etc.). Use list_effects to inspect active effects and remove_effect to end one early.

targets.description: One or more entities to apply the effect to.

entity_type.description: Whether the target is a character or NPC.

entity.description: Slug or UUID of the target.

name.description: Display name of the effect, e.g. 'Hold Person', 'Bless', 'Poisoned'.

source_type.description: Entity type of the caster or effect source.

source.description: Slug of the caster or source. For concentration effects this becomes the concentration owner — clearing their concentration removes the effect automatically.

concentration.description: Set true for spells that require concentration. When the caster's concentration is cleared (via clear_concentration or at 0 HP), this effect is removed from all targets.

duration_rounds.description: Duration in combat rounds. -1 for indefinite (must be removed manually or via save/concentration). When combat is active the expiry round is computed immediately; outside combat the timer starts when combat begins and apply_effect is called again.

end_on_save.description: If present, advance_turn rolls this saving throw at the end of each of the target's turns and removes the effect on a success. Use for Hold Person, Paralyzed, Stunned, Frightened, etc.

ability.description: Ability used for the saving throw.

notes.description: Freeform description of what the effect does mechanically (e.g. 'restrained, attacks have advantage against target'). Not parsed — kept for the DM's reference.
